transcript: Robot: आप सुबह-सुबह इतनी जल्दी कहाँ जा रही हैं? [Where are you going so early in the morning?] Woman: I going school drop my son. Robot: तो ऐसे बोलिए, 'I am going to school to drop my son'. [So say it like this, 'I am going to school to drop my son'.] Woman: मुझे इंग्लिश बोलने में हेसिटेशन होता है। [I feel hesitation in speaking English.] Robot: रोज़ थोड़ी प्रैक्टिस करेंगी तो कॉन्फिडेंस आ जाएगा। [If you practice a little every day, you will get confidence.] Woman: पर प्रैक्टिस कैसे करूँ? [But how do I practice?] Robot: Speakeasy ऐप के साथ। [With Speakeasy app.] Woman: उसमें क्या होता है? [What happens in that?] Robot: मैं आपकी AI टीचर बनकर आपको हिंदी में इंग्लिश समझाऊँगी और स्पीकिंग प्रैक्टिस कराऊँगी। [I will become your AI teacher, explain English to you in Hindi, and make you practice speaking.] Woman: अच्छा, महँगा तो नहीं है? [Oh, is it not expensive?] Robot: नहीं, सिर्फ ₹1 से शुरुआत कर सकती हैं। [No, you can start with just ₹1.] Woman: मैं आज ही इंस्टॉल करती हूँ। [I will install it today.] Presenter: अभी Speakeasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play. Download on the App Store.
summary: An AI robot corrects a mother's English grammar on her way to school, addressing her hesitation to speak. The robot recommends the Speakeasy app, which provides an AI teacher to practice English in Hindi starting at just ₹1. A presenter concludes by urging viewers to download the app.
